standard_prerequisites.name: The characterization of the quasi-DM locus through the diagonal being locally quasi-finite
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4849-4851)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns local quasi-finiteness of the inertia over the descended substack into quasi-DM-ness.

core_obligations: Build the maximal open subscheme: take a smooth presentation, form the inertia fibre product and use the existence of a maximal open subscheme over which the automorphism group space is locally quasi-finite (proof lines 4830-4836)

Descend it: the two inverse images of that subscheme in the presentation groupoid agree because the two projections are isomorphic, so it comes from an open substack and the inertia over that substack is locally quasi-finite (proof lines 4837-4851)
Maximality: any open quasi-DM substack has its preimage contained in the chosen subscheme because its inertia is locally quasi-finite over it (proof lines 4852-4857)

Pointwise form: after a field extension the automorphism group of the point becomes the pullback of the presentation group, so local quasi-finiteness of the automorphism group is equivalent to the point lying in that open substack (proof lines 4858-4885); the unramified assertion is proved in exactly the same way (proof lines 4886-4887)
proof_roadmap: 取满光滑展示 U → X，作惯性方块 G → I_X；由跨章引理存在最大的开子概型 U' 使 G_{U'} → U' 局部拟有限，且其形成与基变换交换。
两次拉回在 R 上相同 ⇒ U' 下降为开子栈 X'，其惯性局部拟有限，故 X' 准 DM。
任何开准 DM 子栈的原像都含于 U' ⇒ 极大性；点层面用基扩张把 G_x 化为展示群的拉回。
(1) 用同一方法配「DM ⟺ 惯性 unramified」的刻画。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a point of an algebraic stack lies in the DM locus exactly when its automorphism group space is unramified over the residue field, and in the quasi-DM locus exactly when that group is locally quasi-finite (author lemma at source lines 4816-4827, label lemma-points-DM-locus). The proof (source lines 4829-4888) constructs the maximal open subscheme of a smooth presentation over which the automorphism group space is locally quasi-finite, descends it through the presentation groupoid to the quasi-DM locus, proves maximality, and identifies the pointwise condition after a field extension, with the unramified case by the identical method (proof lines 4830-4887). The descent of the maximal open subscheme and the pointwise identification are the content. H3.
